verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only time-based rule scheduling and ramp schedules: a rule can 'ramp up automatically over time', which is a one-off progressive rollout, not a recurring job or workflow. Toggling flags from a deploy script via the API is a user-side workaround. No documented capability lets users define recurring scheduled jobs or workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
